title: 2026 Q4 Discount Floor and Margin Sheet

passages.text: The discount floor for the Tessiva Blood Pressure Monitor (BP-220) is NT$39,000 per unit, with a gross margin of about 22%.
The discount floor for the IP-300 Infusion Pump is NT$102,000 per unit, with a gross margin of about 18%.
Any quotation below the discount floor requires approval from the General Manager.
